title: Delta Dental Plan

rows.label: Network
cells: Delta Dental PPO plus Premier Network

rows.label: Coverage A: Diagnostic / Preventive
cells: Delta Dental pays 100%; no waiting period; no deductible

rows.label: Coverage B: Basic Restorative
cells: Delta Dental pays 80%; no waiting period; calendar-year deductible $50 per person / $150 per family

rows.label: Coverage C: Major Restorative
cells: Delta Dental pays 50%; no waiting period; no deductible shown in the Coverage C column

rows.label: Coverage D: Orthodontics
cells: Delta Dental pays 50%; no waiting period; no deductible shown in the Coverage D column

rows.label: Calendar-year maximum
cells: $1,500 per person, potentially up to $3,000 per person with Double-Up Max

blocks.text: **How percentages are calculated:** Benefit percentages are based on actual charges submitted up to the Maximum Allowable Charge for participating dentists, or Delta Dental’s allowance for non-participating dentists.

rows.label: Evaluations twice in a 12-month period, including periodic, limited, problem-focused, and comprehensive evaluations.
Complete-series or panoramic x-rays once in a 5-year period.
Bitewing x-rays once in a 12-month period.
Brush biopsy once in a 12-month period.
Fluoride once in a 12-month period through age 19.
Sealants on permanent molars once every 3 years per tooth for children through age 19.
Clinical crown lengthening once per tooth per lifetime.
Repair of a removable denture to its original condition.
Removable and fixed partial dentures (bridges), and complete dentures.
Correction of malposed (crooked) teeth for dependent children and adults.
If the plan includes an office visit copayment, that copayment does not apply to orthodontic services. This particular outline states the office visit copayment is none.

blocks.text: **Cleaning rule:** Cleanings are limited to two in a 12-month period. The two may be routine cleanings under Coverage A, periodontal cleanings under Coverage B, or a combination of both.
**Annual maximum reminder:** Covered diagnostic and preventive expenses also count toward the annual maximum; they are not excluded from that maximum.
